_readme: HYPOTHESIS REGISTRY — the anti-overfitting ledger for Tier A Daily.
Every idea is written here WITH ITS DATE before its data exists. self_audit.py scores each
one ONLY on rows with scan_date > registered, so every result is out-of-sample by
construction. Thresholds are FROZEN at registration — edit a threshold and you must
re-register with today's date (the old evidence no longer counts).
The Bonferroni bar is 0.05 / (number of ACTIVE entries): adding an idea RAISES the bar
for every other idea. That is the point. Nothing here is ever auto-implemented — a
hypothesis that clears its bar is reported as READY FOR DECISION and a human decides.
Bar for every entry: >= n_min labeled per bucket, corrected p < 0.05, BOTH halves of the
post-registration period agree in direction, effect in the pre-stated direction.

hypotheses.note: Is THIS name panic-priced vs its own sector peers? In-sample 61% vs 14% big winners. 0.0 = missing (excluded).
H1 AND skew_slope<=-1.6. 2026-08-24: skew_slope measured NULL on 51 (p=0.48) — expect this to merely track H1.
IV still bid vs realised. Best robustness of the four on 8/24 (full sample, both halves agree). TDOC 0.51 / INOD 0.59 = lowest in the book, both lost.
POST-ENTRY management signal, not an entry filter. All 9 winners green by d3; 0/3 never-green ever won; TDOC/INOD went green weakly then lost.
Pre-reg 8/17, first look 9/02: R +0.471 vs +0.333, p=0.024, halves agree — FAILED Bonferroni (0.0045). -5% ~ 0.5x ATR: the ATR study's danger bucket. Shadow only.
9/02: R +0.359, p=0.012, halves agree, failed correction. Shadow only.
9/02: p=0.059, halves SPLIT (great early, negative late). Recent tape does not reach far targets.

We discarded ~60% of qualified names by a tiebreaker with NO measured skill. 9/02 clean universe: SKIPPED R +0.518 vs PICKED +0.023, p(picked>skipped)=0.908, Sharpe-ish ~16x. ADOPTED 2026-09-02 (parameters 1.1.0, take_all_qualified=true, max_concurrent=6) — the user's capital decision, live from the 9/03 PM scan. From then on 'skipped' accrues only from the cap; this entry keeps scoring the OLD rule's counterfactual because the archive still records picked_ticker (= top-ranked) beside taken_tickers. If PICKED ever beats SKIPPED on fresh data, that is the signal to revisit.
When EVERYTHING washes out the drop is beta. 9/02: top tercile (176-235) win 44% vs ~60%, n=16, CI spans 0. Gate only, never a signal.
High IV reaches T1 3x faster (median 2d vs 6d, Bonferroni-surviving 8/17) but does NOT improve the outcome — accelerates the stop too. Speed claim only. MOOT if Q5 is adopted.
USER GOAL 9/02: names that start working immediately. Sharper than H5 (d1 not d3). 6 of 9 winners were green on DAY 1. Registered today — scores only on signals after 2026-09-02.
USER GOAL 9/02: which ENTRY metrics (if any) predict days_to_t1 among winners, prospectively. 8/17 found only atm_iv (18 features). Every feature tested is counted in the correction.

From the 9/02 inventory screen of 41 never/rarely-tested fields: the ONLY raw whisper (rho +0.34, p=0.014; ~2 false positives expected at that level). Above-median (90.1) hit-T1 73% vs 38% on 52 resolved. Cboe-style 30d constant-maturity IV from the whole chain; corr with atm_iv only +0.56 so not merely Q8 again. Threshold frozen at the sample median. Must repeat on signals AFTER 9/02.

9/02 screen: fraction of sector peers with FALLING skew vs days_to_t1 among winners rho -0.78 p=0.002 — but n=21 and halves SPLIT, and it has NO effect on whether it wins (p=0.61). Speed claim only; sparse column. Register, do not believe yet.

From the 9/02 FULL post-entry screen (58 metrics x d1-3 x delta+level x 2 comparisons = 408 tests, deltas only while still open; NONE survive Bonferroni p<0.00012; 37 raw hits vs ~20 expected by chance, almost all the IV family = the known high-IV-is-fast effect). The one DISTINCT whisper: call-wall OI LEVEL at day 2 — fast winners ~1,043 vs losers ~135 (p=0.003, n=6/10). May just be liquidity/size. Threshold frozen at the still-open-day-2 sample median (238). POST-ENTRY management signal, not an entry filter. path_labels stores call_wall_oi_d2 from 9/02; scores only on signals after 9/02.

retired.reason: NULL on 51 qualifiers: gap +0.48pp, p=0.482, periods disagree.
ALL REFUTED stop-aware; random-pick hurdle +0.95%/trade. The short side has been tested; no edge.
Raw % triples, R is a wash (+0.434 -> +0.470, CIs overlap). Logged only.
Spearman +0.035 (p=0.835) vs outcomes — no skill. Superseded by Q5 take-all (adopted 2026-09-02).

User idea: does skew / put wall / put-call EVOLUTION after entry separate winners (esp. FAST winners, T1<=5d) from losers — an early-exit tell? FULL screen on 44 resolved qualifiers: ALL 58 numeric metrics x day+1/+2/+3 x delta AND level x (fast-win vs loser, any-win vs loser) = 408 tests, readings taken only while still open (no post-stop leakage), Bonferroni p<0.00012: NONE survive. 37 raw p<0.05 vs ~20 expected by chance — the excess is almost entirely the IV family (atm_iv, near_atm_iv, ticker_vix, call_wall_iv: fast winners ~105 vol at d1 vs losers ~67 = the known high-IV-is-fast LEVEL effect, not a change). Put/call ratio: 20 tests, all p>0.10 (4th time null). Structural skew rises +9..+12 pts after entry in BOTH groups — the qualifying collapse mean-reverts in everyone. Per-trade table of our 16 real trades shows no eyeball pattern either (CRSP pcr -2.09 won, MDB -1.74 lost). Only distinct whisper -> S5. The PRICE tell in the same rows works (red at d1 -> 60% loser vs 21%).

'Red close at day 1 -> 60% loser' is TRUE but ACTING on it LOSES: exit-if-red d1 R +0.089 vs hold +0.269 (trims 12 losers to ~-3% but kills 8 winners that were red at d1 and still ran to +10%); d2 R +0.231; d3 R +0.211; p(better than hold) = 0.84 / 0.57 / 0.75. The day-1 tell is a probability shift, not an exit. Keep H5/S1 as TRACKED signals only; do not build an early exit on them.
